items.question: In how many womb-diagrams are beings said to be tormented?
premises: The number specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are described as tormented.
items.inference: Beings are afflicted throughout the vast array of eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and is inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
